finance.title: Finance
finance.description: What the household is spending, what it has budgeted, and what it is still owed.
finance.uncoveredCurrencies: Spending in {currencies} is not covered by any budget and is not converted.
finance.setBudgetHint: A monthly envelope per category. Changing one starts a new envelope, so past months keep the figure they were reported with.
finance.claimsDescription: Money the household has spent and expects back.
finance.nothingClaimable: Every expense is already on a claim.
finance.noFollowUpLabel: Or say why there is no date

finance.errorNotAuthorized: You are not permitted to do that.
finance.errorInvalidInput: Check the details and try again.
finance.errorAmountInvalid: That amount could not be read. Try 12,34.

finance.importColumns: Needs a header row with Date, Description and Amount. Currency, Category and Merchant are optional. German column names and semicolons work too.
finance.importPreviewCaption: Every row in the file, and how it was read

finance.importNoHeader: That file has a header row and nothing else.
finance.importTooManyRows: That file has too many rows to review at once. Split it and import in parts.
